svg.title: opas: routing LLM requests on model activations
svg.desc: A request in any of four APIs goes through one prefill pass of an encoder LLM; the hidden state of one layer feeds a linear probe that predicts success and cost per model tier; opas routes to the tier with the best success minus lambda times cost.
svg.text: route every LLM request by reading a model's activations
one prefill pass · no tokens generated · a linear probe predicts success and cost per tier
Find the cause and fix it,
residual stream after every layer, read at the last prompt token
OpenAI · Anthropic · Open Responses · Gemini Interactions · tiers small → xlarge · cache-aware · Rust + llama.cpp
